packageRules.description: lib/nrfx is pinned to v3.14.0, the last tag on the pre-4.0 repo layout. nrfx 4.0 moved mdk/ under bsp/, which breaks every Makefile IPATH and board linker script here, so any digest bump past 3.14.0 fails all board builds. Moving to 4.x is a rework, not a digest bump. Remove this rule when that rework lands. See AGENTS.md, Vendored submodules (lib/).
